description: Get market intelligence for one data-center market (by market slug): vacancy, capacity pricing, supply pipeline, main operators and growth.

compare_to.description: Optional second market slug to compare against, e.g. dallas

market.description: Market slug (metro), e.g. northern-virginia, dallas, frankfurt, singapore — valid slugs come from rank_markets / get_market_dcpi_rank

metric.description: Optional single metric to focus on, e.g. vacancy, pricing, absorption, pipeline

period.description: Optional time window for the metric, e.g. ttm, 12mo, ytd

name: get_market_intel
title: Market Intelligence
